item.text: I found the main failure path: URL placeholders are stored globally without a message ID, and restoration accepts any matching placeholder. The Markdown cleanup also strips list indentation and removes ordered list markers. I’m fixing those paths and passing the composer’s message ID through the rendering and insertion calls.
